{{Quote|I am Lord Viun Gaalan, the last man you will ever meet. Much admiration will be accorded me for killing Luke Skywalker. Especially by the family of Lady Rhea, whom you slew.''"<br />"''No, you aren't, and no, it won't.|Viun Gaalan and Luke Skywalker, shortly before the duel|<ref name="lash" />}}
A '''duel''' took place in a [[Dathomir landing meadow|landing meadow]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. After a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|Sith strike team's]] [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|failed attack]] on [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], the two Jedi tracked the strike team's sole survivor, [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]], to Dathomir. When members of her [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|arrived]] to retrieve her, she helped them to [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|capture]] several [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], a group of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri]] [[darksider]]s, who were then taken to the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Sith fleet]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]] and three [[Sith Saber]]s remained behind to take Khai and one last Nightsister, [[Halliava Vurse]], to the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]. However, the Skywalkers and the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]] arrived and attacked the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] while Khai went to retrieve Vurse.

Luke Skywalker engaged Gaalan in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]], while Stadd and the younger Skywalker took on the other three Sith. Stadd shot and killed [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Viun Gaalan)|one]] of the Sith, but [[Unidentified female Sith Saber|another]] attacked Stadd while [[Viun Gaalan's aide|Gaalan's aide]] engaged Ben Skywalker. Working together, Stadd and Skywalker were able to quickly kill both of their opponents. Meanwhile, as the elder Skywalker forced Gaalan backward, Khai arrived on the scene. Taking advantage of the distraction she provided, Gaalan fled in his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], leaving the Jedi to take Khai captive. As the Skywalkers left Dathomir with Khai, however, they were confronted by eleven [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] under the command of the Sith [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]]. Taalon proposed that they form an alliance in order to bring down [[Abeloth]], a powerful dark side being, and the Jedi accepted the offer.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Hey, as long as you're awake, do you mind if I ask you a question?''"<br />"''What are we still doing here, hanging out in the Maw, when we're completely out of food and medicine?''"<br />"''Naw&mdash;I already figured that one out. You put a blood trail on that Sith girl. We're just waiting for her to get her act together and leave Sinkhole Station, so we can follow her.|Ben and Luke Skywalker, preparing to track Khai after the fight at Sinkhole Station|<ref name="Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Vestara Khai, sole survivor of the Sith strike team]]
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith emergence|sent]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] hunted down the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with the intent of [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, in order to pave the way for their intended invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. However, when the strike team [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|attacked]] Skywalker&mdash;who was with his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]], at a [[Sinkhole Station|space station]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]]&mdash;the entire team was killed, except for the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]],<ref name="Abyss" /> who fled the [[Space station/Legends|station]] in a [[Bright Sun|space yacht]].<ref name="lash" />

The Skywalkers tracked Khai to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], hoping to learn the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of her [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Order. However, when they located her planetside, they discovered that she was already under the protection of the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], a group of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]]. On Dathomir, Khai had sent a [[Hypercomm/Legends|hypercomm]] message to the Lost Tribe, calling for them to retrieve her. They sent a team of Sith under the command of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Viun Gaalan]] to pick up Khai and a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]&mdash;[[darksider]]s whom Khai believed could be converted into Sith. After the Sith [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|captured]] the Nightsisters, Khai went to retrieve one more of their number, [[Halliava Vurse]], whom Khai had left in the forest. Gaalan, along with three [[Sith Saber]]s, remained behind in the [[Dathomir landing meadow|landing meadow]] to wait for Khai while the rest of the Sith delivered the captured Nightsisters to their [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]]. Meanwhile, the Skywalkers&mdash;along with the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Dyon Stadd]]&mdash;had been pursuing Khai, and they eventually tracked her to the meadow, where they found Gaalan and the three Sith Sabers.<ref name="lash" />

==The duel==
{{Quote|You are Grand Master Luke Skywalker.''"<br />"''My son, Ben. Our friend, Dyon Stadd.|Viun Gaalan and Luke Skywalker become acquainted|<ref name="lash" />}}
[[File:BenSkywalker_Atlas.jpg|thumb|left|125px|Ben Skywalker]]
Gaalan greeted the Jedi and claimed that he was going to kill the elder Skywalker in revenge for the death of [[Olaris Rhea]], who had led the strike team that had been sent to Sinkhole Station. Gaalan then ignited his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], and the Skywalkers and the three other Sith did likewise. Gaalan and Luke Skywalker instantly engaged in a [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|duel]], and one of the Sith Sabers, [[Viun Gaalan's aide|Gaalan's aide]], attempted to assist the Sith Lord, but Skywalker forced her away. Ben Skywalker, meanwhile, rushed toward [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Viun Gaalan)|one]] of the other Sith Sabers. The young Skywalker suddenly switched directions, however, and the Sith was caught off-balance and dropped his lightsaber. Stadd then shot the Sith four times with his twin [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], killing him.<ref name="lash" />

As [[Unidentified female Sith Saber|another]] Sith Saber attacked Stadd and [[Sun djem/Legends|cut]] through one of his [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], Gaalan's [[Aide/Legends|aide]] began dueling with Ben Skywalker. Meanwhile, Gaalan used a series of intricate and refined blows in an attempt to overwhelm the elder Skywalker, but the Jedi countered his attacks and slowly began to force him back. Stadd, however, was overmatched by his opponent, and was forced to use a series of evasive maneuvers to escape the Sith Saber's attacks. Stadd then feinted as if to dive for the dead Sith's lightsaber while actually just grabbing a handful of dirt, and came up apparently empty-handed. As the Sith Saber moved in, Stadd threw the dirt into the face of Ben's opponent&mdash;Gaalan's aide. She was caught off-guard, and Ben Skywalker quickly [[Sai tok/Legends|cleaved]] her in two at the waist before moving to attack the third Sith Saber.<ref name="lash" />

Meanwhile, Khai had noticed the duel and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force speed/Legends|sprint]] toward the skirmish, hoping to arrive in time to assist her comrades. However, Stadd fired on the last surviving Saber, who deflected the shot toward the young Skywalker, who in turn deflected it back at the Saber. The [[Laser/Legends|bolt]] hit her wrist, and as she staggered back, Stadd shot her in the gut and Skywalker [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] her simultaneously. Khai finally arrived on the scene, and as the Jedi adjusted to her presence in preparation to confront her, Gaalan took advantage of the distraction to leap back into his [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and flee. The elder Skywalker attempted to use the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] the shuttle back down, but Gaalan countered his [[Force power/Legends|power]] and escaped to the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="lash" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Are&mdash;are you proposing a formal alliance?''"<br />"''Precisely.|Luke Skywalker and Sarasu Taalon|<ref name="Allies" />}}
[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|right|155px|Luke Skywalker, Jedi Grand Master]]
Stadd and the Skywalkers confronted Khai, taking her captive, and Stadd took the lightsaber of the first Sith Saber he had killed and decided to keep it. Members of the [[Bright Sun Clan]]&mdash;the clan that had formed when the Raining Leaves Clan had [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|combined]] with the all-[[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Broken Columns Clan]] a short time previously&mdash;arrived and captured Vurse in the forest, where Khai had left her before returning to the landing meadow. As Vurse was convicted by the Bright Sun Clan for her actions against them and officially exposed as a Nightsister, the Clan also allowed the Jedi to take custody of Khai, claiming that&mdash;as she had betrayed their trust by conspiring with Nightsisters&mdash;she was no longer a member of the Clan.<ref name="lash" />

The Skywalkers then left with Khai in the Jedi's [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the ''[[Jade Shadow]]'', but as they approached orbit, they were met by eleven [[Capital ship/Legends|capital-class]] [[ChaseMaster]] [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]] of the Sith fleet.<ref name="lash" /> The commander of the fleet, [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], ordered that the Skywalkers enter a parking orbit and seeing no alternative, the Jedi obeyed. However, to their surprise, the Sith offered to form an alliance with the Jedi in an attempt to defeat [[Abeloth]],<ref name="Allies" /> a mysterious dark side being whom the Jedi had encountered while in a realm of the Force called [[beyond shadows]], and whom they suspected was the cause of a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that plagued several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knights]] in the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]].<ref name="Abyss" /> The Skywalkers were skeptical at first, but eventually accepted the proposal. The alliance was a ploy, however, as the Sith intended to force Abeloth to join them.<ref name="Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
This duel first appeared in ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', [[Aaron Allston]]'s second installment in the [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series and the fourth novel overall in the series.
